capabilities: copy the Publish URL of the current note
open the note's published page in the browser
open the note's Git commit history on GitHub
show a copy-URL entry in the file menu
extras: The GitHub history feature is off by default and needs a repository URL and branch name in settings; a paid Obsidian Publish site is required for the core URL features.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds a command which lets you copy the URL of a note for your Obsidian Publish site.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to get or open the published URL of the note you are editing.

relations.evidence: copy the URL of a note for your Obsidian Publish site
open the current note's Git commit history on GitHub

summary: Command and file-menu entry that copy or open the URL of the current note on your Obsidian Publish site, with optional GitHub commit-history links.
